proposed_combat_encounters.title: Fast Zombies in the Woods
proposed_combat_encounters.outcome: The party looted the zombies and fled without killing them.
proposed_combat_encounters.notes: Three dead commoners rose as unusually fast zombies. Jens stole short swords and the envelope, Nyack stole the longbow, and the party escaped into the mist without killing any zombies.

enemies.name: Zombie
enemies.notes: Three zombies encountered; none were killed in session 2.

proposed_combat_encounters.evidence: The corpses rose as fast zombies; the Triplets stole their possessions and fled.

proposed_combat_encounters.title: Confrontation at the Mansion
proposed_combat_encounters.participants: Party, Strahd's minions, Ismark, Marina, Imp
proposed_combat_encounters.notes: Ismark drew a knife after realizing the party was lying and disguised. Onyx ordered Bluetooth to attack, but the session ended before a completed combat outcome.

enemies.name: Strahd's Minions
enemies.notes: Strahd's minions were present and harassed the party.

proposed_combat_encounters.evidence: Ismark drew a knife and Onyx ordered Bluetooth to attack as the session ended.
